title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 8A: Past events and time
subtitle: Events, past time expressions and words from 8A

words.def: a time when people meet to eat, drink, dance and have fun
words.sent: Morgan was at a ___ at her home last weekend — there was music and dancing.

words.def: a time when two teams play, for example football
words.sent: Antonio was at a ___ in Bristol — it was the Final!

words.vi: buổi hoà nhạc, buổi biểu diễn ca nhạc
words.def: a time when people play music for a lot of people
words.sent: About 1,000 people were at our ___ in Milan.

words.def: a time when people come together to talk about work
words.sent: Cara was at a ___ in Dublin about newspaper photography.

words.def: something important that happens, like a party or a concert
words.sent: A party, a game, a concert and a meeting are all ___.

words.def: a person who takes photos as a job
words.sent: Cara is a ___. She takes photos for newspapers.

words.def: a group of people who play a sport together
words.sent: Antonio is the doctor for the football ___.

words.def: a group of people who play music together
words.sent: Ava sings in a ___ with two guitar players.

words.def: travelling to different cities to play music
words.sent: Last week Ava was ___ with her band — three cities in five days.

words.vi: hấp dẫn, sôi động, gây phấn khích
words.def: making you feel very happy and full of energy
words.sent: How was the game? — It was really ___!

words.vi: thú vị (đáng chú ý, muốn biết thêm)
words.def: making you want to know more
words.sent: Was the meeting good? — Yes, it was really ___.

words.def: something you enjoy doing
words.sent: Was the party good? — Yes, it was a lot of ___.

words.def: not at home, in another place
words.sent: Were you at home at the weekend? — No, I was ___ in Milan.

words.def: a day when you don’t go to work
words.sent: You weren’t at work yesterday. — No, it was a ___ for me.

words.def: the day before today
words.sent: Today I’m in London, but ___ I was in Dublin.

words.vi: cách đây, trước (đặt sau khoảng thời gian)
words.def: before now; we use it after a time, like two days ___
words.sent: I was in Madrid two months ___.

words.def: the evening or night before today
words.sent: Where were you ___? — I was at the cinema at 9 p.m.

words.def: the Saturday and Sunday before this week
words.sent: Morgan, Marcella and Henri were all at parties ___.

words.def: today, before 12 o’clock
words.sent: I was at work ___ and now it’s 3 p.m.

words.def: the year before this year
words.sent: We were in Bristol ___, in 2025.
